size_basis: Cell canvas 24×20; top-left (BX+column×24,BY+row×20), BX=96, BY=9, plus shake. Next pair uses the same grain; ghost uses inset 2 px.

source_preparation.warm_effect_grade: pale cores to 216/169/94; warm R<=208, G<=0.82R, B raised toward 0.30R within G

timing: FALL=20 ticks/cell, SLIDE=5 repeat, LOCK=10 grounded; hard drop immediate. Clear persists 8 ticks, with 8 integer flight positions toward Crock; retry=15 (Board::step, renderer::pot/draw).
